# Sammanfattning
I detta inledande stycke ska du förklara vad labben går ut på, utan att gå in
på detaljer.

# Uppgift 2
### 2.1

```{r}
a <- 26

set.seed(19690420)

n1 <- rnorm(20, a, a)
n2 <- rnorm(80, a, a)
n3 <- rnorm(320, a, a)


lower <- (1 - sqrt(3))*a
upper <- (1 + sqrt(3))*a

u1 <- runif(20, lower, upper)
u2 <- runif(80, lower, upper)
u3 <- runif(320, lower, upper)


t1 <- (a/sqrt(2))*rt(20, 4) + a
t2 <- (a/sqrt(2))*rt(80, 4) + a
t3 <- (a/sqrt(2))*rt(320, 4) + a

plot_numbers <- function(d1, d2, d3) {
  old_par <- par(mfrow = c(2,3),  # 2 rader, 3 kolonner
                 bg = "#1e1e1e", fg = "#e0e0e0", col.axis = "#e0e0e0",
                 col.lab = "#e0e0e0", col.main = "#e0e0e0")
  hist(d1)
  hist(d2)
  hist(d3)
  qqnorm(d1)
  qqline(d1)
  qqnorm(d2)
  qqline(d2)
  qqnorm(d3)
  qqline(d3)
  par(old_par) # säg åt R att sluta förvänta sig fler plottar till samma fönster
  
  par(bg = "#1e1e1e", fg = "#e0e0e0",
      col.axis = "#e0e0e0", col.lab = "#e0e0e0", col.main = "#e0e0e0")
  boxplot(d1, d2, d3, 
          col    = c("#4fc3f7", "#81c784", "#ffb74d"),  
          border = "#e0e0e0",                           
          medcol = "#ffffff",                           
          outcol = "#e0e0e0")
}

plot_numbers(n1, n2, n3)
plot_numbers(t1, t2, t3)
plot_numbers(u1, u2, u3)

```

# Uppgift 3

```{r}
data <- read.csv("olvinsprit.csv", header = TRUE)

land <- data$Land
beer <- data$beer
vin <- data$vin
sprit <- data$sprit


par(bg = "#1e1e1e", fg = "#e0e0e0",
    col.axis = "#e0e0e0", col.lab = "#e0e0e0", col.main = "#e0e0e0")

plot(beer, vin)
text(beer, vin, land)

par(bg = "#1e1e1e", fg = "#e0e0e0",
    col.axis = "#e0e0e0", col.lab = "#e0e0e0", col.main = "#e0e0e0")

plot(beer, sprit)
text(beer, sprit, land)

par(bg = "#1e1e1e", fg = "#e0e0e0",
    col.axis = "#e0e0e0", col.lab = "#e0e0e0", col.main = "#e0e0e0")

plot(sprit, vin)
text(sprit, vin, land)
```

```{r}
plot_numbers(beer, vin, sprit)
```

```{r}
par(bg = "#1e1e1e", fg = "#e0e0e0",
    col.axis = "#e0e0e0", col.lab = "#e0e0e0", col.main = "#e0e0e0")

stripchart(beer, vertical=TRUE)
text(1, beer, labels=land, 
     pos = rep(c(2, 4), length.out = length(beer)),   # 2 = left, 4 = right
     cex = 0.6, col = "#e0e0e0")
```
